name: Bebai
overview: The name Bebai appears in Scripture as identifying the descendants of three Jewish families who returned from exile, as recorded in Ezra and Nehemiah. These passages enumerate the children of Bebai, highlighting their numbers and leadership, such as Zechariah son of Bebai and others like Jehohanan and Hananiah. This consistent mention underscores the restoration and reestablishment of God's people through specific family lines following captivity.
